backup.production_rule: Two nullable columns on cleaning_sessions (session_folder_url text, drive_files jsonb) and one CHECK on the new column. No existing column, row, function or policy changes. Take the backup, fill restore_point/verified_at, apply within one hour.

forward_verification.name: session_folder_url_exists
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'cleaning_sessions' and column_name = 'session_folder_url' and data_type = 'text'

forward_verification.name: drive_files_exists_as_jsonb
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'cleaning_sessions' and column_name = 'drive_files' and data_type = 'jsonb'

forward_verification.name: drive_files_array_check_present
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.cleaning_sessions'::regclass and conname = 'cleaning_sessions_drive_files_is_array'

rollback.safe_until: always (drops the two new columns; Drive and Storage copies are untouched because phase 1 deletes nothing)

steps.name: redeploy_previous_submit_cleaning
steps.action: deploy submit-cleaning from waves 48706d5 so it stops writing drive_files

feature_flags.name: submit_cleaning_writes_drive_archive
feature_flags.required_state: The SPEC-15 submit-cleaning build is deployed only AFTER this release is applied. Deployed earlier, its update of drive_files is refused and logged as 'drive archive not stored'; the report, e-mail and Telegram are unaffected.

compatibility.evidence: Nullable columns only; no reader or writer before this release names them. pgTAP supabase/tests/database/cleaning_drive_archive.sql 6 assertions (catalogue-only, B103); CI runs it on push (no local Docker).

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
